runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, taken wide in straight and made little progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Box seat, switched inside to challenge leaders top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初向內移入以挑戰領先馬匹。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead turning into home straight, headed by winner and weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。轉入直路時率先加速，取得領先。接近終點時被頭馬超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure to challenge leader 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, took the early lead, headed 950M, 2nd in the middle stages, hard ridden from 200M, retook the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。九百五十米處被超越，中段居第二位。自二百米處起受力策，一百五十米處再次取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, led outright after 450m, responded to pressure from 300m out, challenged 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑了四百五十米後單騎領放。自三百米處起對催策交出反應。一百米處受挑戰。未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear after crowded at start, stayed on at the one pace, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。保持同速。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Pressed leader, took narrow advantage 400m out, headed by winner 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追迫領放馬。四百米處以短距離領先。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Commenced well, positioned a length behind the leader, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held up towards centre of course, pushed along 550m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;留後，靠近跑道中央競跑。五百五十米處受推策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, ridden over 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。三百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped and unbalanced at start, raced in midfield, 3 lengths or so back in the middle stages, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間位置，中段落後約三個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, 3 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden after passing 400M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走外欄第四疊。跑過四百米處後受力策。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, weakened from the 500M.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Raced outside of leader, led 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。四百米處取得領先。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled only fairly, never a danger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居後列，走勢僅屬一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, dropped away final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Chased the leader, gave ground passing the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。跑過二百米處時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, nearer to the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，靠近跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to race prominently, shared lead turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時並排領先。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead but trapped 4 wide, shared lead with rivals turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，但走第四疊。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路早段未能再加速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led from pole position, headed final 100M, unable to find an extra gear when being challenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最內檔出閘後領放。最後一百米被超越。受挑戰時未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced 3 wide no cover, kept on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走第三疊，沒有遮擋。僅能保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, checked briefly halfway and unable to hold position, left behind in rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時一度勒避，未能保持位置。最後二百米被拋離，居後列過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderate start, recovered swiftly between runners to take up running over 950M out setting a smart pace on home bend, led until tiring 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後在馬匹之間迅速恢復走勢，九百五十米處取得領先。直路彎以快步速領放。保持領先直至三百米處呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped on terms and settled 3rd towards the middle part of the track, responded only fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居第三位，在跑道中央競跑。對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickened to lead 250m out, headed by winner 50m out, weakened quickly close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。二百五十米處加速取得領先。五十米處被頭馬超越。接近終點時迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length on turn, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Missed the start, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 漏閘，居後列，走外疊。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually close home, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Showed speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 展現前速以領放，受追迫。三百米處被頭馬超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, hard ridden early in straight, checked near 200M, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初受力策。接近二百米處時勒避。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Dispute lead, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;爭奪領先。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened at the top of the Straight, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初轉弱。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W) Took up running just before the 1000M bend, obtained rails run over 800M out, led until headed after straightening, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W) 就在一千米處彎位前取得領先。八百米處移入內欄。保持領先，直至入直路後被超越，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Pressed in front, unable to hold position by halfway and dropped away quickly, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在領放下受追迫。半程前未能保持位置。其後迅速墮退。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。轉弱，最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W5W) Four wide in rear without cover, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W5W) 居後列，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Moderately away from gate 8, raced prominently on the outside, 1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第八檔出閘普通，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, travelled well to turn, challenged the leader after turning in, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。入直路後挑戰領放馬。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced better than midfield but trapped 3 wide, travelled keenly, moved closer after passing 700M, no cover throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，但走第三疊，搶口。跑過七百米處後追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 700m out, never involved, eased 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。七百米處受推策。從未參與競逐。二百米處收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) In rear, unable to quicken under pressure 300m out, one paced and no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。三百米處在催策下未能加速。保持同速，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Slowly away, recovered but towards rear. Pushed along 300m out, no real impression, ran out of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，但居後列。三百米處受推策。無甚表現。最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, settled at the rear, steadied 50m out, failed to run on final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步普通，居後列。五十米處收慢。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Severely checked when crowded shortly after start and lost ground, outpaced and detached throughout, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久在受擠迫之際大力勒避，因而失地。沿途未能跟上步速，被拋離。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Led on the rail, traveled okay, little response in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 沿欄領放，走勢尚可。直路上對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled fairly, weakened notably in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 在力策下取得領先，走勢一般。直路上顯著轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, one paced under pressure, impeded 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。在催策下保持同速。一百米處受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, shared lead turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時並排領先。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier, obtained rails run in front 1000M out setting a steady pace, kicked some 2L clear on straightening but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M and collared close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入內欄，一千米處取得領先，以平穩步速領放。入直路時加速帶離約兩個馬位，但最後一百米後勁不繼，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, under pressure to chase leader 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。四百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Across from wide draw to press leader, struggled to maintain position on bend, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，切入以追迫領放馬。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受催策，沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward to reach 2nd making first turn, chased the leaders into home straight holding every chance until finding no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 首次轉彎時在催策下上前，居第二位。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。一度甚具爭勝機會，直至五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W3W) Tracked pace, raced wide to final bend, improved to hold every chance 150m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎前走外疊。一百五十米處上前，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 350M, weakened early in straight, eased inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百五十米處未能再增速。直路初轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened inside 250M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先。最後二百五十米轉弱。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders against far rail, short of room 300m out, clear run 200m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。三百米處空位不足。二百米處望空。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, steadied near 100M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百米處時收慢，其後再次收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Held up in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 留居後列。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, ridden along 400m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in 2nd, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居第二位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。三百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初轉換跑線以望空。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide with leaders from a poor draw, shifted over 1L back to 4th rounding home bend, kept on without quickening after straightening and faded under pressure inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，與領先馬匹並排，走外疊。轉直路彎時墮後逾一個馬位，居第四位。入直路後保持走勢，未能加速。最後一百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W4W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W4W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat near the rear 2 wide, never quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start losing ground, soon recovered to 9th towards rear on rail, forced to steady when pace slackened onto first turn, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。進入首個彎位步速減慢時被迫收慢。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 9, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled at the rear early, moved closer to midfield passing 800M, held up 400M to 300M before closing off fairly. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段居後列。跑過八百米處時追近至中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困，其後衝刺一般，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Slowly away, made up some ground to race rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, bumped between rivals 200m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，略為追前以居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。二百米處在對手之間發生碰撞。未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W2W) Taken well back on rail, shifted off rail for a run entering straight, only ran past well-beaten runners.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W2W) 留居遙遙落後的位置，走內欄。入直路時移離內欄取位。末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W4W) Eased back after the start to race towards the rear, moved away from inside fence 500M, gave good initial response early straight but could not quicken enough over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W4W) 起步後收慢，留居後列。五百米處移離內欄。直路初起初對催策反應良佳，但末段加速力不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 650M, very wide turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過六百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段追前甚多，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, left behind home straight.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。直路上被拋離。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Towards rear, short-lived headway 300m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。三百米處一度追前。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W5W) Trapped wide with no cover throughout from gate 11, commencing forward move from 700M, had tough run and unable to finish off (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W5W) 自第十一檔出閘。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。自七百米處起開始上前。耗力太多，末段未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along to chase leaders 550m out, short of room in home straight until 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百五十米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上空位不足直至一百米處。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, not enough room final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Towards rear, hampered after 400m, stayed on late into mid-field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列。跑了四百米後受阻礙。末段保持走勢，居中間位置過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken home straight and left behind by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上未能加速，被頭馬拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段對催策毫無反應。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out last from wide draw, still plenty to do top of home straight, making ground when severely checked 250m out, one paced after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初仍落後甚遠。追前，二百五十米處大力勒避，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W3W3W) Held up in rear, tight for room when headway amongst horses over 100m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W3W3W) 留居後列。一百米處在馬匹之間追前之際受緊迫，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Wide in mid-field, forward move 500m out, unable to sustain, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。五百米處上前，其後無以為繼，直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway out wide final bend, chased leaders 200m out, flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。二百米處追趕領先馬匹。末段洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W2W) Raced in last pair, still plenty to do final bend, stayed on into mid-field, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W2W) 居最後兩位之內。直路彎仍落後甚遠。保持走勢，進佔中間位置。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sluggish start and lost ground, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，失地。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W4W) Not the cleanest away and sat near the rear, overracing early stages, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W4W) 出閘欠俐落，居後列。早段搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Away with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2-1/2L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久碰撞對手，居中間之後位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Shared the lead, weakened over the concluding stages, finished off only fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 並排領先。末段轉弱。衝刺僅屬一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on under pressure, snatched third on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持走勢。過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, improved between rivals to challenge 150m out, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。在對手之間上前，一百五十米處展開挑戰。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, looking to improve when short of room 300m out to 200m out, unable to quicken once clear, lost ground final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處至二百米處之間在空位不足下嘗試推進，但望空後未能加速。最後五十米失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved to press leader 1000m out, challenged leader 500m out, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處上前追迫領放馬。五百米處挑戰領放馬。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W1W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield early, moved closer after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, 2-1/2L back turning in, peaked on run 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走第三疊。跑過一千米處後追近，中段居第二位。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。二百米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled down in midfield about 4Ls off the pace, switched wide from 700M before giving limited response in the straight. Couldn't sustain run late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位。自七百米處起移出外疊。直路上對催策反應有限。末段未能保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly, ridden along to lead, gave ground and failed to respond over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 搶口，在催策下取得領先。末段墮退，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, forced three wide final bend, pushed along, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎走第三疊。受推策，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide from 600M, challenged the leaders turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。入直路時挑戰領先馬匹。趨近二百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Shifted out shortly after start, 2nd in the early and middle stages, travelled keenly and lost position near 700M, raced slightly better than midfield on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑。早段及中段居第二位，搶口。接近七百米處時失位。直路彎居中間稍前位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, sent forward to race in 2nd early, allowed rival to cross near 800M, 4 lengths back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，早段受催策上前居第二位。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1050M, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。跑過一千零五十米處後追近，入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, taken widest final bend, no extra final 150m and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎被帶出最外疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, under pressure 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。四百米處受催策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, minor progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 350M, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Hampered at start, waited with in rear, keen early, driven along 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受阻礙，居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Raced close up, effort early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路初發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, slightly weakened passing the 150M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居前列。跑過一百五十米處時略為轉弱。衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along 500m out to chase leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受推策，追趕領放馬。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, travelled keenly, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先，搶口。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Clean jump, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, kicked top of home straight, headed 200m out and weakened quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。直路初加速。二百米處被超越及迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rivals on turn, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領先。直路彎受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Heavily bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 700m out, driven 400m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處移離內欄。四百米處受催策。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, showed good speed to lead, joined by rivals top of home straight, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 躍出時發生碰撞。展現甚快前速，領放。直路初被對手追上，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, 9 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
Blood in trachea.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後九個馬位。末段保持同速。
氣管內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 to 6 lengths back in the middle stages, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。中段落後五至六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the inside early, moved a bit closer along the rail in the middle stages, 4 lengths back turning in, angled out early in straight, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。早段居後列，走內疊。中段沿欄略為追近。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W3W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍，對頭兩名馬匹未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 550M, a bit closer on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。自五百五十米處起走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W2W2W) Raced wide, improved to press leader 1100m out, unable to hold position 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W2W2W) 走外疊。千一米處推進以追迫領放馬。四百米處未能保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Settled at rear, traveled smoothly, made up ground in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走勢暢順。直路上追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, effort 400m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。四百米處發力。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 450M, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W4W5W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, failed to make any progress in straight, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded at start, settled midfield on the inside, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫。居中間位置，走內疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 起步時被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，走第二疊。四百米處開始上前。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Raced rear, switched out at the Turn, limited response when placed under pressure (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, not enough room early in straight, showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段空位不足，其後對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W3W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 3 wide towards rear, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, kept on evenly in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，發生觸碰，居後列，走第三疊。中段略為追近。直路上保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W2W) Mid-field, keen mid-race, quickened between horses 150m out, sustained run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。一百五十米處在馬匹之間加速。持續上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 2 wide, carried wider 450M, finished off very strongly, won by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居第三位，走第二疊。四百五十米處被帶出較外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，以短距離之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat toward rear, switched out rounding the Turn, showed some dash over the final 100M, just missed.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。最後一百米略為加速上前，僅敗。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, hard ridden from 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。自三百米處起受力策。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, picked up prominent position under pressure onto first turn, obtained one back rail position in 3rd about 750M out, hung on well for 2nd in straight without ever threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞。開始轉首個彎位時受催策，佔取前列位置。約七百五十米處佔取第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw travelling keenly on heels in early stages, 3-wide in rear rounding home bend swinging widest into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後留後。早段搶口，緊貼他駒後蹄。轉直路彎時居後列，走第三疊。入直路時移出最外疊，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Mid division, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後一百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, held up last, head in air 700m out, switched wide for clear run 250m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，留居包尾位置。七百米處昂首。二百五十米處移出外疊以望空。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮退。入直路時受推策，走外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear 7Ls back, kept to inside in the straight, closed off well but couldn't be ridden out to the finish final stages when awkwardly placed. Could do better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後七個馬位。直路上固守內疊。衝刺良佳，但末段處於窘境之際未能被力策至終點。本應可交出更佳表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Out with rest, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from gate 10, raced in midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take a place, nearest finish. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Close up early, gradually taken over 2L back in 5th and 3-wide without cover rounding home bend, weakened under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段緊隨領放馬。轉直路彎時逐漸留居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, dropped back to race towards the rear 5Ls off the pace, made some inroads towards the finish but failed to seriously threaten at any stage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生碰撞，墮居後列，落後領放馬五個馬位。末段略為追前，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, struggled to hold position from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Maintained a position in midfield, came under pressure home turn and dropped away on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策。入直路時墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) With leaders on rail early stages, ceded position for one-back 4th onto home bend, in similar position near the rail into straight, kept on same pace under pressure without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段與領先馬匹並跑，走內欄。開始轉直路彎時墮後一個馬位，居第四位。入直路時居相若位置，靠近內欄競跑。末段在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策毫無反應，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Across to press leader, under pressure 500m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well from the one draw niggling along early, gradually settled about 2L back in 3rd from over 800M out, obtained a clear run over 200M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策。自八百米處起逐漸居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。二百米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 12, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Made running, challenged 300m out, saw off that rival after sustained battle, headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處受挑戰。持續力拼，力拒對手。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W3W2W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 700M, 2nd on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W3W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後追近。直路彎居第二位。二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight for room close home, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。接近終點時受緊迫，以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on but no match to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, kept on fairly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Keen early, settled in mid-field, forward move wide final bend, challenged 150m out, unable to sustain effort.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W4W) 早段搶口，居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。一百五十米處展開挑戰，但無以為繼。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, closed off strongly for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat handy 2 wide, raced keenly in the middle stages, kept on well under whip to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。在鞭策下保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Across from wide draw to press leader, chased leader into home straight, weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。入直路時追趕領放馬。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final 300M. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側，最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 800M, retook the lead turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策上前，取得領先。接近八百米處時被超越。入直路時重奪領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Failed to show his usual gate speed and had to settle close to rear, shifted in abruptly across heels to obtain clear room 350m out, stayed on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;未能展現一貫前速，居接近後列位置。三百五十米處急促向內移入，橫越對手後蹄以望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, headed in the Straight, kept on nicely for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。直路上被超越。保持佳勢，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Soon in front from draw 1, pressed by rival in the lead throughout, headed inside 300M, weakened over final 200M. (Jockey could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，瞬即取得領先。領放，沿途受對手追迫。三百米處被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old colt, by Zoustar from Aristia, a daughter of Lonhro. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Theta and Californiatotality. The fellow was given six trials for two wins and four placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and won by a short-head under slight pressure, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on June 22. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished third under pressure, beaten by 3-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 22. He looks an interesting debutant here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)之後，在港同父馬包括「手機錶霸」及「加州動員」等駒，生母出自「白金礦」(Lonhro)。抵港後六次試閘得兩勝四位。6月22日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下以短馬頭位之先勝出。最近10月22日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬3.75個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled wide with cover just better than midfield in 7th or 6th just over 3L off the lead, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間稍前的第六或第七位，落後領放馬稍逾三個馬位，走外疊，有遮擋。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 14, raced towards rear on outer, 4 lengths or so back, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自第十四檔出閘，留居後列，落後約四個馬位，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, short of room early in home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初空位不足。末段速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Prominent early dropping over 2L back to joint 4th rounding home bend, one-paced in straight in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。轉直路彎時墮後逾兩個馬位，並居第四位。直路上衝刺時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Tracked pace, a bit outpaced 500m out, tended to hang right top of home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。五百米處略為被拋離。直路初傾向內閃。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently on the inside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Raced in rear, struggled to hold position final bend, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居後列。直路彎難以保持位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Mid-field, well placed on heels of leaders 400m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處居好位，緊隨領先馬匹。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Soon prominent, led outright after 400m, pressed on 300m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 瞬即居前列位置。過了首四百米後單騎領放。三百米處受追迫。一百米處被超越，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W2W2W) Mid division, pushed along wide into home straight, tended to shift right in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路上傾向向內斜跑。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 800m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處一度受阻礙。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led early, headed after 500m, remained prominent, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 早段領放。跑了五百米後被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, stayed on but outpaced by leaders final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能跟上領先馬匹的步速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Mid-field, rail position throughout, unable to quicken for pressure 200m out, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，沿途走內欄。二百米處在催策下未能加速。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader, unable to keep tabs on that rival from 300m out, stuck to task to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起未能跟上領放馬。持續力拼，保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, inconvenienced near 900M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時受妨礙。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路初空位不足，一百五十米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, moved closer on turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點。末段僅能力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead final 50m, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞及失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in last few for rails run from a wide barrier, commenced move entering home straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時開始上前。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, ridden top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) Waited with towards rear, raced keenly throughout, dropped to last place top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初墮退至包尾位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat towards rear, traveled smoothly, held up at the top of the Straight and again over the final 50M, could not be fully tested.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走勢暢順。直路初及最後五十米兩度受困，未能全力施為。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, taken wider 500m out, tended to hang right in home straight, unable to improve position.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百米處被帶出較外疊。直路上傾向內閃，未能推進。
（於二百米騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, running into trouble top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初受阻，未能望空直至二百米處。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, lay in and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。內閃，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, ridden along in the turn, never a threat. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策，從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Moderate start, gradually recovered to prominent position, one back in 2nd 2-wide rounding home bend, faded under pressure inside final 350M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，逐漸恢復走勢，居前列。轉直路彎時居第二位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。最後三百五十米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Crowded at start, raced wide in mid-field, weakened over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, recovered to race in mid-division 5Ls off the pace, placed under pressure from 500M but only battled in the straight. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。恢復走勢，居中間位置，落後領放馬五個馬位。自五百米處起受催策，但直路上僅能勉力而為。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Raced in rear after awkward start, switched wide for clear run 300m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，其後居後列。三百米處移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Raced up with leader, weakened over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 與領放馬並跑。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail near 750M, 5Ls or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。接近七百五十米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Recovered from awkward start to race in touch, pushed along turning into home straight, faded final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後恢復走勢，緊隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時受推策。最後三百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 3 wide with cover, 3 lengths back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，落後三個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped awkwardly, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙，落後領放馬一個半馬位，在跑道中央競跑。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Away well, raced prominently, 2 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，居前列，走外欄第三疊。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened and eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, travelled keenly, run peaked final 150M.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。搶口。最後一百五十米未能再加速。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled off pace 2 wide, closed off okay. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
(Roarer.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列。入直路時須等待空位出現。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。
（患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Crowded leaving stalls, held up in rear, stayed on final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘時受擠迫，留居後列。最後二百米保持走勢，超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Mid-field, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位疊。最後一百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure 700m out to chase leader, one paced under pressure, flattened out close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。在催策下保持同速。接近終點時洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Wide early, disputed lead, still every chance 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 早段走外疊，爭奪領先。一百米處仍甚具爭勝機會，但末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W) Began swiftly and tracked pace, unable to slot in and face the breeze throughout, momentarily struck the front 150m out and boxed on solidly, despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。未能切入內疊，沿途沒有遮擋。一百五十米處一度取得領先，儘管耗力甚多，仍持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, run peaked at the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。直路上向外移出。以佳勢上前。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began fairly gradually improved to 5th some 3L back on rail, angled out for a run entering home straight, obtained a clear run 250M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，逐漸推進至第五位，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位。二百五十米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 700m out, good headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。七百米處開始上前，走外疊。直路彎追前甚多。直路上持續上前。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back, 3 wide from 500M, a length or so back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先，保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W3W) Wide early, tracked pace, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，跟隨領放馬。自二百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, pushed along over 400m out, soon lost position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策，其後瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Wide throughout, raced close up and keen, upsides leaders turning into home straight, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 沿途走外疊，緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。轉入直路時上前追迫領先馬匹。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W4W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made some headway from the 500M, gave ground final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起略為追前。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, not much impression made, raced flat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居後列。無甚表現，走勢平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, forced to steady 1400m out, tight for room 400m out, switched in against rail for clear run 100m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千四米處被迫收慢。四百米處受緊迫。一百米處切入內欄以望空。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, traveled ungenerously at the early stages in the box-seat, fail to quicken at the straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段居包廂位置，走勢欠順。直路上未能加速。（ 見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway wide back straight, chased leaders into home straight, no extra final 75m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。對面直路上上前，走外疊。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後七十五米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Sat towards rear, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居後列，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W4W) In rear, pushed along and wide turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列。轉入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W3W3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, had trouble finding clear running early in the Straight, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Wide in mid-division, lost place turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in worse than midfield in 8th, ridden from 800M out and given reminders from 400M out, forced to check and switch for a run over 200M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間之後第八位。自八百米處起受催策。自四百米處起受鞭策。二百米處被迫勒避及轉換跑線取位。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W4W) Amongst leaders early drifting backward to midfield onto home bend, steadied for a stride 700M out, switched wide for a run entering straight, ran on well to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W4W) 早段居領先馬群中。開始轉直路彎時墮居中間位置。七百米處一度收慢。入直路時移出外疊以取位。以佳勢追前，終點線上僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, hard ridden after passing 450M, wide into straight, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, held up at the early Straight, no clear run until 150M, finished off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。直路初受困，未能望空直至一百五十米處。衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Sat last, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Held up, last and plenty to do top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 留後。直路初居包尾位置，落後甚遠。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead 2 wide, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in midfield, baulked for a run early in straight and checked 250M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路早段受困。二百五十米處勒避，其後從未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled keenly early, made steady ground inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。最後一百五十米穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Held up, keen early, headway towards rail from 200m out, never going pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受約束，早段搶口。自二百米處起沿欄追前。從未能加速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W4W4W) Held up in rear, taken wide final bend, stayed on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W4W4W) 留居後列。直路彎移出外疊。最後二百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Keen in mid-field, angled wide to make effort 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 中段搶口。三百米處移出外疊以發力，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Moderately away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, kept on well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空。保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, switched to chase leaders into home straight, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時轉換跑線，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed 300m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon in front setting the pace, pressured in the lead by rivals from 700M, run ended mid-straight and gave way.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領放，主宰步速。自七百米處起在領放下受對手追迫。直路中段無以為繼，墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped cleanly, vied for lead first half of the race, couldn't quicken passing 400M, faded away final 200M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘俐落。賽事前半段爭奪領先。跑過四百米處時未能加速。最後二百米力竭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 1 took up early running before relinquishing the lead near 800M, retook the lead 150M but lay in forcing jockey to stop riding momentarily. Edged out to 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，於早段領先。接近八百米處時失去領先優勢。一百五十米處再次取得領先，但內閃，導致騎師一度須停止催策。接近終點時被超越，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, took the lead, led by a length on turn, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。直路彎領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled worse than midfield 3 wide, stayed on. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段保持走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Pressed forward after moderate start from the wideset barrier before settling 3-wide without cover in 5th just over 2L back, 3L 6th 3-wide rounding home bend, ran on in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘普通後受催策上前，其後居第五位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時居第六位，落後三個馬位，走第三疊。直路上追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly from draw 1, settled in the group chasing leaders, responded well on straightening, led nearing 200M, kept on to the line but couldn't hold off winner final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居於追趕領先馬匹的馬群中。入直路時對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時領先，但最後一百五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能展開真正挑戰。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W3W) Rear of mid-field, wide throughout, stayed on steadily final 200m, went third late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走外疊。最後二百米保持穩勢。末段進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at rear on the inside, 2 wide in the middle stages, angled out early in straight, cleared 200M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走內疊。中段走第二疊。直路早段向外移出。二百米處望空，其後略為追前。
