runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Soon taken back from the widest barrier travelling wide in last few to straight, made short-lived effort between 400 and 200M, found no extra thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即留後，直路前居最後數位之內，走外疊。四百米處至二百米處之間一度發力，其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Shifted in at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 850M, same margin back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。自八百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon taken well back from a wide barrier travelling mainly 4-wide without cover, made headway towards rear inside the 850M, one of the widest into straight, ran home one-paced while hanging out under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置，大多走第四疊，沒有遮擋。八百五十米處略為追前至後列。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。末段保持同速，在催策下外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickly lost place early in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。追迫領放馬。直路初迅速失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on until weakened final 100M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，直至最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of midfield, commenced move upon straightening, ran on well under pressure to reach 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時開始上前。其後在催策下以佳勢上前，末段進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W3W) Raced in touch, smooth headway into contention 300m out, chased leader from there, on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處以暢順走勢上前，躋身爭勝行列。自該處起追趕領放馬。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W) From draw 11 positioned close to the pace but caught wide no cover throughout, kept on soundly in the straight to finish a respectable 3rd despite the tough journey.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，緊隨領放馬，但沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管際遇欠佳，但直路上仍保持不俗走勢，取得季軍，表現可嘉。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in 4th about 2L off the pace, commenced move between runners entering home straight but unable to quicken under pressure throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。入直路時在馬匹之間開始發力，但沿途在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway onto heels of leaders bend, one paced under pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前緊隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Settled in midfield near the rail, saved ground turning in for home, improved under pressure to reach distant 2nd over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，靠近內欄競跑。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程，在催策下上前，一百五十米處進佔第二位，落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W3W) Wide throughout, forward move to chase leaders 500m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W3W) 沿途走外疊。五百米處上前追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, briefly hampered 500m out, short of room 100m out, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處一度受阻礙。一百米處空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Trailed the field throughout after slow start, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後沿途尾隨馬群。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W4W) Jumped only fairly , settled at the back of the field, brought wide into straight but gave no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。入直路時移出外疊，但對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat behind midfield near center track, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat near the rear on the rail, lay in and never seriously tested, did made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居後列，走外欄。內閃，從未能真正施為。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow(-) (4W3W3W) Not the quickest out, taken back from the wide draw, stayed on well.
Substantial blood.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速(-)(4W3W3W) 自最外檔起步，出閘並非最快，留後。保持佳勢。
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear, not much luck in running, never fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，陣上取位欠順。從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, responded reasonably well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢尚可。在鞭策下反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Settled within 3L of pace in 5th on rail, snuck closer turning in for home holding every chance on the inside early in straight until 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，居第五位，走內欄。轉入直路時追近。直路早段走內疊，一度甚具爭勝機會直至五十米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W3W) Sat handy on the rail, showed good dash early part of the Straight, hit the front at the 200M, weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W3W) 居前列，走內欄。直路早段以佳勢加速上前。二百米處取得領先。最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W1W1W) Taken back to last from the widest barrier trailing the field to home straight, ran on past well-beaten ones inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路前尾隨馬群。最後一百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield, lay in in the early Straight, gave ground inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初內閃。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride towards the rear, brought wide into straight before running on moderately to the finish. Posed no threat to first three however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。入直路時移出外疊。保持不俗走勢至終點，但未能對頭三名馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Held up last after crowded leaving stalls, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，其後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，毫無表現。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Proisir from Miss Vegas, a daughter of Carlton House. Horses by the same sire include Sunny Da Best and Flow Water Flow. He was given three trials for one win and two placings in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and won by a neck, under a hold, over 1200m on turf at Happy Valley on October 9. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished second under a hold, beaten by 2Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 22. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: Proisir之後，在港同父馬包括「新力好」及「細水長流」等駒，生母出自「嘉登行宮」(Carlton House)。抵港後三次試閘得一勝兩位。10月9日出試谷草1200米，早段居中，末段按韁下以一馬頸位之先勝出。最近10月22日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第二名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。初出有一爭之力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, angled out 350M, made some progress early in straight, crowded near 100M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。中段落後六個馬位。三百五十米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。接近一百米處時受擠迫，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well in the middle stages, headed near 450M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，受催策上前領放。中段走勢良佳。接近四百五十米處時被超越。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, weakened over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Made contact at start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, made contact near 400M, 3-1/2L back turning in, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近四百米處時發生觸碰。入直路時落後三個半馬位。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Moved across to the fence shortly after the start from a wide barrier, raced tight in the home straight and unable to be fully ridden out until the last 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後不久切入內欄。直路上緊迫競跑，未能被全力催策直至最後一百米。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W) Sat near the rear, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Always well behind, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 一直遙居於後。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, raced towards rear, switched wide entering home straight and hampered rival, edged left and remained down centre of course, stayed on (finished second, demoted to third).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列。入直路時移出外疊及阻礙對手。其後向外斜跑，留在跑道中央競跑，保持走勢。（第二名過終點，被貶為第三名。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, struggling to go pace from halfway, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。自半程起難以跟上步速。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Settled slightly worse than midfield, unable to slot in somewhere from gate 11, drifted backwards and lost position 400M out, failed to run on when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自第十一檔出閘後未能切入，居中間稍後位置。四百米處墮後，失位。在催策下未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat at the rear, weakened and gave ground quickly in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列。直路上迅速轉弱及墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，接近終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 800M, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走第二疊。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。最後一百米收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, lost position after passing 750M, positioned 4 wide, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。跑過七百五十米處後失位。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位，走第四疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Dropped back on jumping from draw 14, raced as the back-marker throughout, had big task in hand 400M but couldn't make any progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十四檔躍出，墮後。沿途居包尾位置。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure home straight, in third place briefly over 100m out, outpaced final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路上受催策，保持走勢。一百米處一度居第三位。最後五十米速度不及前列馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Keen under restraint in mid-field, short-lived headway over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在受約束下搶口，居中間位置。二百米處一度追前。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。搶口。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off some weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Began well from a poor draw, gradually shifted backward to worse than midfield, commenced move on top of home bend over 500M out, ran on from 3L back into straight to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，逐漸留後至中間之後位置。直路彎早段五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後三個馬位，其後追前，最後數步獲得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure to maintain position from 800m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自八百米處起在催策下保持位置。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Raced in rear, under pressure halfway out to chase leaders, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居後列。半程時受催策，追趕領先馬匹。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Away in line, restrained to a rearward spot 6Ls off the pace, had task ahead top of the straight but was just fair through the line. Never reached contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，在約束下居後列，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。從未有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide in mid-field without cover, driven along 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W) Dropped back to race in second half of the field, pushed along 550M and brought wide for home, closed off nicely to go 3rd last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 墮居後半馬群中。五百五十米處受推策。入直路時移出外疊。末段衝刺良佳，最後一步跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段以勁勢上前，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Tailed-off throughout and never seen with a chance.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 沿途居包尾位置。從未看似有力一爭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (4W2W3W) Always at the back, detached from approaching home bend.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(4W2W3W) 沿途居包尾位置。趨近直路彎時被拋離。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (4W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(4W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, taken back to race towards rear on the middle track, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, one-paced final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通。留居後列，在跑道中央競跑。中段落後約六個馬位。最後四百米保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders towards centre of course, ridden along 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, crowded and lost balance 600m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover, eased once well held.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫及失去平衡。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, rail position throughout, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。沿途走內欄。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Crowded at start, waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, in midfield early stages before dropping back towards the rear, brought wide into straight but the finishing response was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W5W) 出閘笨拙。早段居中間位置，其後墮居後列。入直路時移出外疊，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (3W2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, same position on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W3W4W) Raced wide, started well but soon settled back into mid-field, pushed along 400m out, stayed on well final 200m and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W3W4W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處受推策。最後二百米保持佳勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, towards rear and pushed along top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 沿途走大外疊。直路初居後列，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on but no further impression late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W4W) Away well enough, restrained to race in midfield, had 5Ls to make up on leader 400M, ran on steadily to the line for 4th without troubling the easy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W4W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬五個馬位。末段穩步上前，取得第四名，未能威脅輕鬆勝出的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, lacked pace to challenge.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百米處。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd on rail, gained closer on the inside turning in for home, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時追近，走內疊。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat midfield, traveled fairly, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。走勢普通。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Raced in touch, chased down leaders under pressure over 200m out, stayed on well, beaten little distance in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, made good ground along the inside. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段沿內疊追前甚多。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, was hampered over the concluding stages, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居前列，走勢良佳。末段受阻礙。其後衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped start, positioned 2 wide, 1-1/2L back, angled out after passing 600M, showed good response early in straight, peaked 200M, ran on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，落後一個半馬位，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。直路初對催策反應良佳。二百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Disputed lead, ridden to lead outright 300m out, challenged from 200m out, responded gamely when runner-up got upsides 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 爭奪領先。受催策，三百米處單騎領放。自二百米處起受挑戰，一百米處被亞軍馬匹追上，但對催策反應甚佳掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W4W) Crowded for the first 150M settling 3-wide in last few, widest into home straight, ran on well inside final 150M near the centre of the track.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W4W) 首一百五十米受擠迫，居最後數位之內，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊。最後一百五十米在接近跑道中央以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway 500m out, unable to sustain in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處略為追前。直路上無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Commenced well, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 500M, no clear run early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。直路早段未能望空。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, joined leader 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。六百米處追上領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed forward to be racing in 2nd, fought on one paced in the straight before weakening out of contention final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 受催策上前，居第二位。直路上保持同速。最後一百米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W) 3-wide in midfield early stages from a wide barrier gradually improving from 900M out to be 1.5L 3rd 700M out remaining 3-wide, joined leaders briefly making final turn but soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自九百米處起逐漸推進。七百米處居第三位，落後一個半馬位，仍走第三疊。轉直路彎時一度追上領先馬匹，但瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide with cover, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Out with the line and sat 3-wide behind the leaders on settling, could not muster any sort of challenge in the straight and weakened passing 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊。直路上從未能展開挑戰。跑過三百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide behind midfield, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Niggled along in forward of midfield on rail, steadied up in slackened tempo rounding home bend, baulked behind runners after straightening, quickened well inside final 150M to just get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策，居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎步速減慢時收慢。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後一百五十米加速良佳。終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sat towards the rear, no clear run, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列。未能望空。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, pushed along 600m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in rear of mid-field against rail, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置，走外欄。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide from 600M, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, travelled keenly, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側，搶口。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, sat near the rear, made no impression
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。毫無表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Shooting To Win from Tanzanite, a daughter of Jet Spur. Horses by the same sire include Dragon Four Seas and Leslie. He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh under the whip, beaten by 5-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Shooting To Win之後，在港同父馬包括「騰龍四海」及「風繼續吹」等駒，生母出自「噴射快駒」(Jet Spur)。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第七名，落後頭馬5.75個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (3W2W2W) Showed early speed to dispute lead, kept on nicely to the line
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 展現前速，爭奪領先。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Mid-field, opened up for him against rail early in home straight, chased winner from 200m out, never looked like reaching that rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置。直路早段沿欄望空。自二百米處起追趕頭馬，從未看似能追及對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 2 wide, 1 to 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，落後一至兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, some headway under pressure 200m out, flattening out when hampered 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處在催策下略為追前。五十米處受阻礙之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled in worse than midfield, in similar position into home straight, briefly baulked over 200M out, ran home one-paced without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處一度受困。末段保持同速，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W4W) Fast break, waited with in rear, commenced move out wide 400m out, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居後列，留力候上。四百米處開始上前，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled okay, weakened passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 在力策下取得領先，走勢尚可。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well in the middle stages, headed near 300M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，受催策上前領放。中段走勢良佳，接近三百米處時被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made all, quickened top of home straight, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。直路初加速。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, ridden top of home straight to challenge leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W4W) Slow to begin, settled towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W4W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sped forward crossing to the lead, slowed down the pace one in front, headed near 300M and couldn't sustain run final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 加速上前，切入領放，隨即減慢步速。接近三百米處時被超越，末段無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W4W1W1W) From draw 12 caught wide no cover when going forward first turn, reached the lead 1100M and took them along at a slightly slow pace, headed mid-straight, faded late but managed to hold on for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W4W1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘。首個彎位上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。千一米處取得領先，以偏慢步速領放。直路中段被超越。末段力竭，但保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, pressed by rivals to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。率先加速，直路初領先。受對手追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, tracked pace out wide, dropped away quickly top of home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，被碰撞及失去平衡，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初迅速墮退。遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, briefly impeded 500m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處一度受阻礙。自三百米處起受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on outer, struck heels and blundered near 1000M, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近一千米處時踢中對手後蹄及失蹄。入直路時落後四個半馬位，直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Box seat, under pressure 400m out, well placed into home straight, ran on well final 200m to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。四百米處受催策。入直路時居好位。最後二百米走勢良佳，過終點時僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, blundered 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百米處失蹄。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Clean jump, raced in 2nd, a length back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 出閘俐落，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Lowered its head as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, severely checked 1400m out, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 開閘時將頭低俯，失地，居後列。千四米處大力勒避。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W3W) Reserved behind midfield, pace very slow first half of the race, switched away from fence 400M, ran on steadily to the line without threatening first three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W3W) 留居中間之後位置，賽事前半段步速非常緩慢。自四百米處起移離內欄。末段以穩勢上前，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, gained 6th into back straight about 4L back, swung one of the widest into straight, responded well inside final 200M to hit the front 100M out and soon kicked clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入對面直路時進佔第六位，落後約四個馬位。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。最後二百米對催策反應良佳。一百米處取得領先，瞬即帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and pressed on from a wide draw to lead by 1L on settling, offered little on straightening and was easily accounted for.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，在催策下領先一個馬位。入直路時再無餘力，其後被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W1W) Tracked pace, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, dropped to rear middle stages, struggling in home straight, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段墮居後列。直路上掙扎上前，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, showed good speed to lead, soon joined by rivals top of home straight, headed by runner-up 200m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，展現甚快前速領放。直路初瞬即被對手追上。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, raced prominently, briefly checked 500m out, twice bumped 350m out to 200m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居前列。五百米處一度勒避。三百五十米處至二百米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well in straight, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。中段輕鬆領放。入直路時領先一又四分一馬位。直路上保持佳勢，末段力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Settled in second half of the field, waited with until passing 400M but lacked a kick in the straight. (Both Trainer and Jockey indicated their horse was not suited to the slow tempo of the race in the middle stages.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居後半馬群中。留力候上直至跑過四百米處，但在直路上未能加速。（練馬師及騎師均表示賽事中段的緩慢步速不合此駒發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, kept on well to the line without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近最後一百米時。保持佳勢至終點，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, dropped to rear of mid-field on bend, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, strong run to lead on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。直路彎墮居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。衝刺強勁，終點線上取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled 3-wide in rear of midfield from a poor draw, inconvenienced 350M out, ran on dourly under pressure to gain upper hand close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百五十米處受妨礙。末段在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Settled at the rear, switched out top of Straight, stay on well. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居尾列。直路初向外移出。保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled smoothly, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居後列，走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Made contact at start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 5Ls back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear, still in rear into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。入直路時仍居後列。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in and heavily bumped out of stalls, waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生大力碰撞。居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策，末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled down midfield in a fast run race, came with a decent finish passing 300M, just couldn't hold off winner late stages in a race won at class record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 在快步速下居中間位置。跑過三百米處時衝刺不俗。僅於末段未能抗衡以刷新班次紀錄的時間取勝的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Stuck to inside rail throughout, mid-field, clear run in home straight, stayed on to edge ahead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，沿途固守內欄。直路上望空。保持走勢，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and made heavy contact, raced better than midfield on rail, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, bumped 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處發生碰撞。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Reserved in midfield along the fence 3-4Ls back, in similar position turning home, ran on well final 300M, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 沿欄留居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。最後三百米以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide, improved to press leader 900m out, ridden 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。上前，九百米處追迫領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。趨近一百米處時未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, short of room early in home straight, badly held up for clear running final 150m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。最後一百五十米嚴重受困而未能望空，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to vie for lead obtaining rails run in front just inside the 1200M, held over 1L advantage into straight but unable to sustain effort and caught 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，爭奪領先。跑過千二米處後在領放下移入內欄。入直路時領先逾一個馬位，但其後無以為繼，五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, easy run to turn, angled out early in straight, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路初向外移出。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on well but headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初加速。二百米處取得領先。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但不敵頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W2W) From draw 12 moved forward to take up a trailing position behind leaders, drifted back to midfield when leaders went fast middle stages, failed to finish off in the straight
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘後上前，佔取領先馬匹之後有遮擋的位置。中段在領先馬匹加速之際墮居中間位置。直路上未能以勁勢加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting back to behind midfield some 7L off the pace in back straight, renewed effort 3-wide rounding home bend and wider into straight, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。對面直路上留居中間之後位置，落後領放馬約七個馬位。轉直路彎時重新發力，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。走勢平穩，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞及失去平衡，居第二位，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。末段保持穩勢。
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W2W2W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W2W2W4W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, found rail near 950M, shared lead on turn, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時移入內欄。直路彎並排領先。直路初未能再增速，被超越。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail near 700M, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初略為追前。最後二百米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, 3 wide on turn, made some progress until approaching 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步略為緩慢及受擠迫，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。略為追前直至趨近五十米處。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, found daylight near 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。接近一百五十米處時望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leaders, driven along 500m out to chase leaders, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide, 3 lengths or so back, no cover on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Settled well back from the widest draw, made short-lived effort between the 800 and 600M, made no further impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後遙居於後。八百米處至六百米處之間一度發力。直路上再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, bumped near 500M, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。接近五百米處時發生碰撞。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure 700m out to chase leader, faded final 200m, forced to steady 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。最後二百米力竭。一百五十米處被迫收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初望空，末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked one length clear top of home straight, stayed on well but headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭。直路初加速帶離一個馬位。保持佳勢，但終點線上被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策，取得領先。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W1W) Across from widest draw to lead, set strong pace, joined and headed 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後切入內疊，以快步速領放。四百米處被追上及超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Pressed forward from a middle draw eventually joining leader 2-wide on first bend 1200M out, became one-out-one-back in 3th 700M out, ran home one-paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自中檔出閘後受催策上前，千二米處首個彎位追上領放馬，走第二疊。七百米處居第三位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, chased leader, ridden to press leader 400m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與一駒互相碰撞，追趕領放馬。四百米處在催策下追迫領放馬。最後一百米轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Wootton Bassett from Fife, a daughter of Starcraft. Horses by the same sire include Viva Chaleur and Stunning Peach. This fellow had thirteen starts for one win (a 3yo Group 2 over 1600m) and three placings (including a 2yo Group 2 over 1100m). He was given two trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He was taken back and finished third, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf at Happy Valley on October 9. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and won by 2Ls under slight pressure, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 22. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「活頓鎮」(Wootton Bassett)之後，在港同父馬包括「爆熱」及「桃花開」等駒，生母出自「星球爭霸」(Starcraft)。來港前在澳洲十三戰得一勝三位，頭馬為一場1600米三歲二級賽，上名賽事包括一場1100米兩歲二級賽。抵港後兩次試閘得一勝一位。10月9日出試谷草1200米，起步居後，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。最近10月22日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下以兩個馬位之先勝出。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure from approaching home turn 400M out, tight between runners 100M out, ran on closing stages to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，自四百米處趨近直路彎時受催策。一百米處在馬匹之間受緊迫。末段追前，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W) Checked shortly after start, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, hung in 300m out, ran on strongly final 100m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W) 起步後不久勒避，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。三百米處內閃。最後一百米以勁勢追前。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 300M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空，三百米處望空。保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang right in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路上傾向內閃。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Soon took up running holding narrow advantage, went some 1L clear upon straightening and hung on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 瞬即領放，以短距離領先。入直路時帶離約一個馬位，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, hung right under pressure home straight, no extra final 150m.
(Blood at both nostrils but no blood in trachea so was deemed not to have bled.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Blood at both nostrils but no blood in trachea so was deemed not to have bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路上在催策下內閃。最後一百五十米再無餘力。
（兩邊鼻孔有血，但氣管沒有血，故不被視為流鼻血。）
