runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) From draw 2 obtained a midfield position on settling, brought wide top of the straight before staying on mildly to take 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 自第二檔出閘，居中間位置。直路初移出外疊。其後保持普通走勢，接近終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground settling in last few, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced in midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well, gradually settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced without quickening under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Driven along after the start but failed to show sufficient pace going forward, ended up racing behind mid-division, couldn't make up ground in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步後受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前，居中間之後位置。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, stayed on strongly, in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。保持勁勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 12 eased back to sit at the tail of the field, cut the corner home turn, stayed on down the inside but never looked like getting to first two which finished well clear from the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，收慢留居包尾位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。其後在內疊保持走勢，但從未看似能追上已帶離馬群的頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Outpaced early stages and settled in 2nd half of the field 5-6Ls off the pace, had the job ahead 400M, closed off mildly but was never a winning hope.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未能跟上步速，居後半馬群，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠。衝刺普通，從未有望爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Held up in mid-pack along the inside, lay in for most part of the straight, gave limited response only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，走內疊。直路上大部分途程內閃，對催策反應僅屬平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) From wide draw taken across behind runners, raced at the rear along the inside, was finishing well but got held up between 150M-50M. Would have finished closer.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，在馬群之後切入，居後列，走內疊。衝刺良佳，但一百五十米處至五十米處之間受困。本應可跑得更為接近。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off very strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，衝刺凌厲，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W5W) Settled well behind from the widest barrier, went widest into home straight, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W5W) 自最外檔出閘，遙居於後。入直路時走最外疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled ahead of midfield, 4Ls behind leader 400M, closed off well under pressure for equal 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，四百米處落後領放馬四個馬位。在催策下衝刺良佳，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, short of room 300m out to 200m out, eye-catching headway from rear final 100m, hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。三百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。最後一百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。接近終點時受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, some headway up rail in home straight but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。直路上沿欄略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, not enough room until approaching final 100M, kept on well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。空位不足直至趨近一百米處。保持佳勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped swiftly from middle of the line but happy to let the speed go, settled slightly worse than mid-pack, closed off well despite laying in concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自中檔出閘迅速，讓領先馬匹上前，居中間稍後位置。儘管末段內閃，但衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Began well amongst leaders, taken one-out-one-back to 3rd 900M out and 3L back in 4th over 500M out, renewed effort 3-wide into straight and hit the front 150M out despite shifting ground under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居領先馬群中。九百米處佔取第二疊第二位，居第三位。五百米處居第四位，落後三個馬位。入直路時重新發力，走第三疊。一百五十米處在催策下斜跑，但仍取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide with cover, 5 to 6 lengths back, very wide turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(5W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，落後五至六個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Out in line, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, a length back turning in, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on outer, travelled keenly throughout the early stages, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。早段沿途搶口。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, followed runner-up into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。跟隨亞軍馬匹入直路。自四百米處起受催策，但未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前，獲得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover early stages, improved to track leaders two wide with cover 600m out, effort 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊，有遮擋。四百米處發力，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Caught wide no cover chasing leaders, had no extra final 200M and weakened out of contention. (Jockey - obliged to make use early stages to hold a forward position.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力，轉弱，再無爭逐機會。（騎師表示，他須於早段催策坐騎以佔取前列位置。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, kept on very well in straight, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持甚佳走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(+) (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead early stages, disputed led middle stages, bumped 350m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(+)(3W1W1W) 早段展現甚快前速以領放。中段爭奪領先。三百五十米處發生碰撞。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Very wide in prominent 4th in early stages, within striking distance for place chance turning into straight only to be denied a placing final stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 早段居前列第四位，走大外疊。入直路時有機會爭入位置，僅最後數步未能入位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W2W2W) Showed great speed to press leader, challenged leader from 350m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W2W2W) 展現甚快前速，追迫領放馬。自三百五十米處起挑戰領放馬。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Soon led, controlled race from front, two lengths ahead turning into home straight, responded to pressure from 200m out, unchallenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，在領放下主宰步速。轉入直路時領先兩個馬位。自二百米處起對催策交出反應，未受挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on nicely to the line, just won.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持佳勢至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, gave ground slightly passing the 150M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策以領放。跑過一百五十米處時略為墮退。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a smart pace mid-race, kicked over 1L clear after straightening but unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 70M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，中段以快步速領放。入直路後加速帶離一個馬位，但無以為繼，最後七十米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, unable to quickened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路上未能增速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Clean jump, raced prominently on the inside, travelled well to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the first few on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘俐落，居前列，走內疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路初取得領先。保持佳勢，但過終點時未能抗衡頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W2W3W) Pressed forward steadily from the widest barrier sharing 2nd within 2L of pace from the 800M, unable to sustain effort from 2L 3rd into straight, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，在催策下穩步上前。自八百米處起並居第二位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。入直路時居第三位，落後兩個馬位，無以為繼，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from draw 1, vied for early lead before easing back to track leaders, driven to challenge for the lead again early straight, proved no match for first two passing 200M, lost 3rd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段爭奪領先，其後收慢以跟隨領先馬匹。直路初在催策下再度爭奪領先。跑過二百米處時不敵首兩名馬匹。接近終點時失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, taken wider 600m out, driven along 400m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處被帶出較外疊。四百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, dropped to rear turning into home straight, switched inside early in home straight, bumped 150m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時墮居後列。直路早段移入內疊。一百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Positively ridden out the gate and obtained a leading position as expected, pressed by rival throughout the race, couldn't sustain run final 150m and gave ground late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘後受積極催策，一如預期取得領先。沿途受對手追迫。最後一百五十米後繼無力。末段墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made running, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 50m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。直路初加速。五十米處被頭馬超越。僅能保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Crowded after the start, pushed forward to track leader on outside, briefly took over early straight, run ended 150M from home and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，受推策上前，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初一度領先。一百五十米處無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, under pressure throughout, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。沿途受催策。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at tail, 6 lengths back turning in, taken wide in straight and made some headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made steady ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, challenged up rail from 200m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受推策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, there to turn, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Made contact at start, positioned 2 to 3 lengths behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生觸碰。落後領放馬兩至三個馬位，走外欄第三疊。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Prominent in 3rd from a wide barrier, one-off the rail rounding home bend, weakened under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，居前列第三位。轉直路彎時走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier to soon take up running on the rail, led until joined 600M out, unable to sustain effort and swamped 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至六百米處被追上。其後未能保持走勢，一百五十米處被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, driven along 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Led early, ceded advantage for one-back 2nd after the first 200M, re-gained lead in home straight 300M out kicking over 2L clear over 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段領先，過了首二百米後被超越，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路上三百米處重奪領先位置。一百五十米處加速帶離逾兩個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a fast pace in middle stages, led the field until headed 250M out and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段以快步速領放。帶頭競跑，直至二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米被後上馬匹過頭，失去三甲位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(-) (3W2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, commenced move out wide 500m out, very wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(-)(3W2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百米處開始上前，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Raced keenly early stages when being restrained to obtain a position behind midfield, had over 5Ls to make up 400M, came with a strong finish and drove hard late stages to just get the verdict.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 早段搶口，在約束下居中間之後位置。四百米處落後逾五個馬位。末段以勁勢衝刺，在力策下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Bumped at the start, held up towards the rear 6-7Ls off the pace, had some work to do 400M, responded well when asked but was denied clear running from 100M to the finish. Inconclusive run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。四百米處仍落後甚遠。對催策反應良佳，但自一百米處起未能望空至終點。未能全力發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from the one draw but soon dropped to last few on rail, commenced run upon straightening and ran on well to be nearest finish.
(Sustained an abrasion to left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，但瞬即墮居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時開始發力，以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。
（左後腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, settled down midfield 3-4Ls off the pace, kept up the chase on leaders final 300M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位。最後三百米保持追趕領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W3W) From draw 12 given a waiting ride, raced keenly near last in a 3-wide position without cover, brought widest for home before making some progress to finish midfield.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留力候上。居接近包尾位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋，搶口。直路上移出最外疊，其後略為追前，居中間位置過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained in mid-division along the fence, close enough to leaders passing 300M, did best work late and was nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。跑過三百米處時落後領先馬匹不遠。末段表現最佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(-) (3W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(-)(3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。五百米處受推策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Close up early before taken back to midfield in 6th first turn, in similar position into home straight, ran on down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。首個彎位留居中間第六位。入直路時居相若位置。沿跑道中央上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Guided to race along the fence in midfield, in a similar spot turning home, finished off moderately under a big weight but couldn't be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。在負重磅下衝刺普通，但末段在緊迫競跑之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Midfield throughout, kept on steadily without quickening in straight, inconvenienced about 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 沿途居中間位置。直路上保持穩勢，未能加速。約一百米處受妨礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, tight of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百五十米處。最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, made no progress final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。最後一百五十米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, ridden top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路初受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, joined by rivals 600m out, headed top of home straight, stayed on well to fight back and lead 100m out, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入以領放。六百米處被對手追及。直路初被超越。末段保持佳勢，一百米處反先對手取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on well final 200m, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米以佳勢追前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden top of home straight to chase leader, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初受催策以追趕領放馬。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made contact early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初發生觸碰。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Pressed forward, emerged as leader 850M setting good pace to straight, headed by winner near 250M, faded late to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 受催策上前，八百五十米處取得領先。直路前以中等步速領放。接近二百五十米處時被頭馬超越，末段力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Up with leaders early stages before settling down in a trailing position just off the pace, kept on one paced under top weight on straightening, always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 早段跟上領先馬匹，其後居領放馬稍後有遮擋的位置。入直路時在負頂磅下保持同速，一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped well from gate 12, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Travelled wide without cover in rear of midfield after beginning from a wide barrier, obtained cover towards rear in 8th inside the 700M, swung wide for a run into straight, ran on down the apparent fast strip to be nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處居後列第八位，取得遮擋。入直路時向外移出以望空。末段沿大外疊追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Lost considerable ground at start, soon recovered to rear of the field while racing keenly 1000M out, tight behind runners on rail inside the 600M, switched for a run over 200M out producing good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 起步時失地甚多。瞬即恢復走勢，居後列，一千米處搶口。六百米處在馬群之後受緊迫，走內欄。二百米處轉換跑線取位，末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Sat ahead of midfield just over 2Ls off leader, brought wide from 400M, loomed up and fought hard, briefly in front 150M but run ended passing 100M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。自四百米處起移出外疊。其後在力拼下上前。一百五十米處一度取得領先，但跑過一百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, tracked leaders, travelled strongly final bend to lead top of home straight, stayed on, headed by front three close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎走勢強勁，直路初取得領先。保持走勢，接近終點時被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden to take up running 950M out and rails run 800M out, kicked some 2L clear in front rounding home bend, just held off strong challenges in straight to prevail narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策，九百五十米處取得領先，八百米處移入內欄。轉直路彎時加速帶離約兩個馬位。直路上力拒對手的強勁挑戰，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Caught racing wide in midfield, hung in throughout and responded only fairly in the straight. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途內閃，直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Held a position behind midfield, swung wide into straight for his challenge but made limited progress only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰，但僅能略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Overshare from Street Goddess, a daughter of Street Cry. Horses by the same sire include Metro Power and My Day My Way. This fellow had one start for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1100m). He was given seven trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat not far off the pace and finished second under the whip, beaten by a short-head, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 3-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: Overshare之後，在港同父馬包括「精彩福星」及「好節拍」等駒，生母出自「街頭口號」(Street Cry)。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1100米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後七次試閘一次上名。10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段鞭策下跑第二名，落後頭馬短馬頭位。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬3.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start to 9th, saved ground turning in for home, ran on well down the inside of straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居第九位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上沿內疊以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, bumped 150m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊。一百五十米處發生碰撞。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide better than midfield, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Sustained a laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（右後腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, settled behind midfield, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙。居中間之後位置。末段穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, short of room 250m out to 150m out, lost all chance and allowed to coast home.
Lame in right hind leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受推策。二百五十米處至一百五十米處之間空位不足。其後再無爭逐機會，獲許順其自然地競跑至終點。
右後腿不良於行。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Jumped well, gradually taken back to 5th some 3L back 800M out, renewed effort from wide into home straight, ran on steadily under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速。八百米處逐漸留居第五位，落後約三個馬位。入直路時重新發力，走外疊。最後二百米在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride behind mid-division, brought wide to challenge passing 400M before staying on steadily for modest 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 早段未受催策，居中間之後位置，留力候上。跑過四百米處時移出外疊以展開挑戰。其後保持穩勢，取得第五名，表現一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked on run near 100M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初追前頗多。接近一百米處時未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W6W) Wide in mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W6W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初難以保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Mid-field, smooth headway into contention 300m out, quickened to lead 200m out and soon in control, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處以暢順走勢上前，躋身爭勝行列。二百米處加速以取得領先，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, under pressure on bend to chase leaders, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W1W1W) Ridden to slender lead from a wide barrier, obtained rails run over 600M out, led until headed 200M out and swamped for a placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策，領先短距離。六百米處移入內欄。保持領先，二百米處被超越。末段再被後上馬匹超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent early, dropped to 3L back in 5th 600M out, produced late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列。六百米處墮居第五位，落後三個馬位。最後一百米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W2W) Across to settle in mid-field, switched to secure clear run 200m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W2W) 切入居中間位置，二百米處轉換跑線以望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, got across to track leaders, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on well but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，切入內疊以跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Soon took up running obtaining rails run early in back straight, led the field until joined over 250m out, fought on well under pressure but found fast-finishing winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭。對面直路早段移入內欄。保持領先，二百五十米處被追上。在催策下以佳勢力拼，但未能抗衡衝刺凌厲的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden on bend to chase leaders, travelled smoothly for clear run top of home straight, narrow lead 150m out, no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。走勢暢順，直路初望空。一百五十米處以短距離領先。末段不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W4W) Settled in midfield 3-wide and without cover at times in back straight, one of the widest turning in for home, kept on at the same pace without threatening and steadied closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。對面直路上不時沒有遮擋。轉入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一。保持同速，未能構成威脅。末段收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the early and middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away only fairly from the middle of the line, recovered to be midfield one off, held up briefly at the home turn, travelled to the line ok (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自中檔出閘僅屬一般，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎一度受困。末段走勢尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W) Settled in rear 3-wide from the widest barrier, commenced move and wider rounding home bend, finished off the race well inside final 150M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，居後列，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，走更外疊。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, caught in a pocket behind front two against rail when trying to challenge 150m out, switched 100m out, ran on well and still closing at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處嘗試沿欄展開挑戰時在頭兩名馬匹之後坐包廂。一百米處轉換跑線。末段以佳勢追前，過終點時仍持續追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught racing 3-wide without cover towards the tail of the field, couldn't muster the pace to challenge on straightening. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居尾列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時未能加速以展開挑戰。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Dropped back on jumping from draw 11, settled at the rear 6Ls back, lacked a change of gears in the run to the line. Never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘後墮居後列，落後六個馬位。末段缺乏加速力。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Began well from the one draw settling just off the pace in 3rd, drifted further off the lead to over 2L back in 4th 600M out, weakened under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後第三位。六百米處進一步墮居第四位，落後領放馬逾兩個馬位。最後二百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, held up for clear running 300M to 100M before fading away final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 保持落後領先馬匹不遠。三百米處至一百米處之間受困而未能望空。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Awkward start, raced very wide without cover throughout, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Blundered badly on jumping with jockey becoming unbalanced and the horse losing ground, settled near rear throughout and couldn't go on turning into the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 躍出時嚴重失蹄，導致騎師失去平衡，失地。沿途居後列。轉入直路時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W3W) Bumped and became unbalanced at the start, settled towards the rear 6Ls away, wide into the straight but couldn't finish off when asked. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，落後六個馬位。入直路時走外疊，但在催策下衝刺乏力。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）
